The example client library is published for several languages.

Install the client

Python

pip install example-client

Java

implementation "com.example:client:1.0"

Shell

curl -O https://example.invalid/client.tar.gz

Configure the client

On Linux, write the settings file under your home directory.

On Windows, write the settings file under your profile folder.
Note: The client reads the settings file once, when it starts.
